MOD = 10**9 + 7

    n, m = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    adj = defaultdict(list)
    for _ in range(m):
        u, v = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())

        adj[v].append(u)

    size = [0] * (n + 1)
    depth = [0] * (n + 1)
    is_cycle = [False] * (n + 1)
    cycle_nodes = set()

        size[u] = 1
        for v in adj[u]:
            if v == p:

                is_cycle[u] = True
                is_cycle[v] = True
                cycle_nodes.add(u)
                cycle_nodes.add(v)

            depth[v] = depth[u] + 1
            dfs(v, u)
            size[u] += size[v]
